title: BACK↔PO-001: API Readiness + Service Status Reporting
description: Backend provides service status, scaling/cost reporting, and API readiness; Product Owner/TPM provides feature requirements for cloud-side processing/APIs/integrations, prioritization, and SLAs, and requires service-readiness status, API contract changes affecting frontend/firmware, and scalability constraints. Grounded in BACKEND_CLOUD_ENGINEER_SKILL §6.9 and PRODUCT_OWNER_TECHNICAL_PROJECT_MANAGER_SKILL §6.8.

api_contract_changes.description: API contract changes affecting frontend/firmware (downstream notification).

x-macp.tier_rationale: Routine API-readiness and status reporting is agent-autonomous. A breaking API contract change must be notified to FE/FW and, if it alters a ratified interface contract, requires a CCR + version bump (Tier-2).
x-macp.cadence: TRIGGER (requirement intake; milestone reviews; cost/SLA review; dedicated checkpoint before any release with cloud-side dependencies)
confirm_conditions: every breaking api_contract_change lists its affected_consumers (FE/FW)
scalability_constraints surfaced against the PO's SLA targets
api_readiness = READY only when the release-blocking endpoints are live
reject_conditions: a breaking API change reported without notifying affected FE/FW consumers
api_readiness = READY asserted while service_status = DOWN/DEGRADED on the release path
a ratified interface contract altered without a CCR + version bump
counter_conditions: SLA target conflicts with the current scalability ceiling (SCALE-4/PERF-3) — request a scope or capacity decision
API contract change ambiguous in blast radius — request a consumer-impact analysis before sign-off
